# Spuro 0.2.0

Adds read-only session archaeology and proactive UNKNOWN reconciliation.

- Ingest existing normalized session artifacts and reviewed deja-vu sync JSONL
  from producer versions 0.21.5/0.21.6; no provider commands or index refresh.
- Correlate observable criteria per intent, including cached Git equivalence,
  dirty state, explicit continuations and cancellations. Coverage and confidence
  remain separate; partial visibility never establishes abandonment.
- Run `spuro sessions reconcile --input existing-sessions.json` without another
  repository audit. Group exact sightings, expose evidence gaps, and rank fuzzy
  follow-up suggestions separately from deterministic matches.
- Keep the default report focused, retain candidates in versioned JSON, and
  expose session phase timings with verbose progress.

UNKNOWN reconciliation never changes lifecycle states. Fuzzy similarity is an
inspection lead, not completion proof. Independent audit CSV/custom JSON schemas
are not inferred. Session reports can contain private paths/IDs; keep them local.
Private laptop-corpus acceptance and semantic/squash equivalence remain gaps.

Requires native Git for estate/session scans; offline reconciliation needs no
Git/provider executable. No cleanup, rescue refs, fetches, uploads, or resumption.

AGPL-3.0-only. Archives include Spuro, both optional analyzer adapters, README and
LICENSE for Linux/macOS/Windows on amd64/arm64. Verify against SHA256SUMS.
